e.title: SOA 创新通讯
e.summary: SOA Entrepreneur & Innovate 通讯：精算创新的官方资讯源
e.body:
SOA（北美精算师协会）Entrepreneur & Innovate 通讯（newsletter）：精算创业与创新的官方资讯——AI/数据/新业务模式的精算创新动态。对 RIAA：精算创新的官方资讯流——与 [[soa-practice-view-ai]]（SOA AI 网播）、[[soa-ai-life-challenge]]（SOA AI 竞赛）构成 SOA 创新三件套：资讯 + 教育 + 实战；跟踪 SOA 对精算创新的关注方向（AI/创业/产品创新）；面试/研究的行业前沿素材。

e.summary_en: SOA Entrepreneur & Innovate newsletter: the official news source of actuarial innovation
e.summary_hk: SOA Entrepreneur & Innovate 通訊：精算創新的官方資訊源
e.body_en:
The SOA (Society of Actuaries) Entrepreneur & Innovate newsletter: official news of actuarial entrepreneurship and innovation — actuarial innovation dynamics in AI/data/new business models. For RIAA: the official news feed of actuarial innovation — with [[soa-practice-view-ai]] (SOA AI webcast) and [[soa-ai-life-challenge]] (SOA AI competition) it forms the SOA innovation trio: news + education + practice; track SOA's innovation focus (AI/entrepreneurship/product innovation); industry-frontier material for interviews and research.
